hindi: और इनको धन के बदले स्थान, छत्र, पगड़ी और आभूषण प्रदान करे।
english: And for money he should give these [persons] positions, parasols, turbans and ornaments.
notes: hiraṇya is rendered "money" here and throughout (literally "gold"). Genitive eṣām stands for "to these"; the persons meant are not named in this unit. The instrumental hiraṇyena is taken as the price.
lines_deva: स्थानच्.छत्र.वेष्टन.विभूषाश् च-एषां हिरण्येन प्रयच्छेत्
lines_iast: sthānac.chatra.veṣṭana.vibhūṣāś ca-eṣāṃ hiraṇyena prayacchet

words.gloss: to be enjoyed by a non-śrotriya
of one whose house is burnt

hindi: पाषण्ड-संघ का द्रव्य, या अश्रोत्रिय के उपभोग की सम्पत्ति, या देवता का द्रव्य, कृत्यकर लोग "मृत व्यक्ति के या जले हुए घर वाले के हाथ में रखा हुआ" ऐसा कहकर प्रस्तुत करें।
english: The task-doers should present the property of a pāṣaṇḍa saṅgha, or property to be enjoyed by a non-śrotriya (one not learned in the Veda), or a deity's property, as "deposited in the hand of a dead man or of one whose house is burnt".
notes: kṛtya-kara is taken literally as "those who do the task" (probably the agents); sense uncertain. pāṣaṇḍa-saṅgha could also be a dvandva "pāṣaṇḍa and saṅgha". The referent of the claim (to whom it is presented) is not stated. kṛtya in Book 12 (kṛtya-pakṣa) means the seducible; that sense is not adopted here, kṛtya-kara stays literal.
lines_deva: पाषण्ड.सङ्घ.द्रव्यम् अश्रोत्रिय.उपभोग्यं देव.द्रव्यं वा कृत्य.कराः प्रेतस्य दग्ध.गृहस्य वा हस्ते न्यस्तम् इत्य् उपहरेयुः
lines_iast: pāṣaṇḍa.saṅgha.dravyam aśrotriya.upabhogyaṃ deva.dravyaṃ vā kṛtya.karāḥ pretasya dagdha.gṛhasya vā haste nyastam ity upahareyuḥ

words.gloss: of the deities of fort and country

hindi: देवता-अध्यक्ष दुर्ग और राष्ट्र के देवताओं का, प्रत्येक के अपने अनुसार, एक स्थान पर स्थित कोश बनाए, और उसी प्रकार प्रस्तुत करे।
english: The superintendent of deities should make a treasury of the deities of the fort and of the country, each according to its own, kept in one place, and just in the same way should present [it].
notes: yathā-svam is obscure; literally "as is its own". "it" (the treasury) after upaharet is not in the Sanskrit and is understood.
lines_deva: देवता.अध्यक्षो दुर्ग.राष्ट्र.देवतानां यथा.स्वम् एकस्थं कोशं कुर्यात्, तथैव च-उपहरेत्
lines_iast: devatā.adhyakṣo durga.rāṣṭra.devatānāṃ yathā.svam ekasthaṃ kośaṃ kuryāt, tathaiva ca-upaharet

words.gloss: holy place of a holy man

hindi: देवता के चैत्य को, सिद्ध के पुण्य स्थान को, या औपपादिक को रात में खड़ा करके यात्राओं और सभाओं से जीविका चलाए।
english: Having set up at night a caitya of a deity, a holy place of a holy man, or an aupapādika one, he should make a living by processions and gatherings.
notes: aupapādika is obscure (from upapāda "sudden appearance"?); left untranslated. utthāpya is taken as "having set up/raised"; the object is the three items listed.
lines_deva: दैवत.चैत्यं सिद्ध.पुण्य.स्थानम् औपपादिकं वा रात्राव् उत्थाप्य यात्रा.समाजाभ्याम् आजीवेत्
lines_iast: daivata.caityaṃ siddha.puṇya.sthānam aupapādikaṃ vā rātrāv utthāpya yātrā.samājābhyām ājīvet

words.gloss: by a tree of a caitya grove
endowed with out-of-season flowers and fruits

hindi: अथवा चैत्य के उपवन के वृक्ष से, जो बेमौसम के फूल और फलों से युक्त हो, देवता के आगमन की घोषणा करे।
english: Or by a tree of a caitya grove endowed with out-of-season flowers and fruits he should make known the coming of the deity.
notes: devatā-abhigamana could also mean "going to the deity" (approach to the deity).
lines_deva: चैत्य.उपवन.वृक्षेण वा देवता.अभिगमनम् अनार्तव.पुष्प.फल.युक्तेन ख्यापयेत्
lines_iast: caitya.upavana.vṛkṣeṇa vā devatā.abhigamanam anārtava.puṣpa.phala.yuktena khyāpayet

words.gloss: agents in the guise of holy men

hindi: अथवा वृक्ष पर मनुष्य का हाथ और राक्षस का भय दिखाकर सिद्ध के वेश वाले गुप्तचर नगरवासियों और जनपदवासियों के लिए धन से उसका प्रतिकार करें।
english: Or, having displayed a human hand and fear of a rakṣas on a tree, agents in the guise of holy men should counteract [it] for the townsmen and country people with money.
notes: manuṣya-kara is doubtful: kara may be "hand" (taken here) or "maker/doing" (man-made thing). prarūpayitvā "having displayed/represented". "[it]" is the object of pratikuryuḥ, not stated. hiraṇyena is probably the payment taken for the remedy; kept literal.
lines_deva: मनुष्य.करं वा वृक्षे रक्षो.भयं प्ररूपयित्वा सिद्ध.व्यञ्जनाः पौर.जानपदानां हिरण्येन प्रतिकुर्युः
lines_iast: manuṣya.karaṃ vā vṛkṣe rakṣo.bhayaṃ prarūpayitvā siddha.vyañjanāḥ paura.jānapadānāṃ hiraṇyena pratikuryuḥ

hindi: अथवा सुरंग से युक्त कुएँ में अनियन्त्रित सिर वाले नाग को धन की भेंट के साथ दिखाए।
english: Or, in a well fitted with a tunnel, he should show a serpent with an unrestrained head, with an offering of money.
notes: aniyata-śiraska is obscure; literally "whose head is not restrained". nāga could be serpent or snake-deity. The audience of the showing is not stated. aniyata may also mean 'not fixed in number' (indefinite number of heads); kept literal.
lines_deva: सुरुङ्गा.युक्ते वा कूपे नागम् अनियत.शिरस्कं हिरण्य.उपहारेण दर्शयेत्
lines_iast: suruṅgā.yukte vā kūpe nāgam aniyata.śiraskaṃ hiraṇya.upahāreṇa darśayet

words.gloss: in an image of a nāga
in a hole of a caitya
in a hole of an anthill

hindi: नाग की प्रतिमा में, जो भीतर से ढकी हो, या चैत्य के छिद्र में या बाँबी के छिद्र में, भोजन से जिसका संकेत बँधा हो ऐसा बनाकर, श्रद्धालुओं को सर्प का दर्शन कराए।
english: In an image of a nāga hidden within, or in a hole of a caitya or in a hole of an anthill, having made [it] one whose signal is bound by food, he should show the sight of a serpent to the faithful.
notes: pratibaddha-sañjña: sañjñā is "signal" or "awareness"; the serpent is presumably meant (trained by food), but the Sanskrit does not name it as object of kṛtvā. Genitive śraddadhānānām stands for "to the faithful".
lines_deva: नाग.प्रतिमायाम् अन्तश्.छन्नायां चैत्यच्.छिद्रे वल्मीकच्.छिद्रे वा सर्प.दर्शनम् आहारेण प्रतिबद्ध.सञ्ज्ञं कृत्वा श्रद्दधानानां दर्शयेत्
lines_iast: nāga.pratimāyām antaś.channāyāṃ caityac.chidre valmīkac.chidre vā sarpa.darśanam āhāreṇa pratibaddha.sañjñaṃ kṛtvā śraddadhānānāṃ darśayet

hindi: अविश्वासियों के आचमन और प्रोक्षण में विष का प्रयोग कराकर देवता का अभिशाप बताए; अथवा अभित्यक्त को डसवाकर।
english: Having caused poison to be administered in the sippings and sprinklings of the unbelieving, he should declare the curse of the deity; or, having caused a condemned man to be bitten.
notes: rasa = poison (glossary). The second alternative has no main verb of its own; brūyāt is understood. By what the man is bitten is not stated.
lines_deva: अश्रद्दधानानाम् आचमन.प्रोक्षणेषु रसम् उपचार्य देवता.अभिशापं ब्रूयात्, अभित्यक्तं वा दंशयित्वा
lines_iast: aśraddadhānānām ācamana.prokṣaṇeṣu rasam upacārya devatā.abhiśāpaṃ brūyāt, abhityaktaṃ vā daṃśayitvā

words.gloss: by remedy of the showing of the contrivance

hindi: अथवा योग के दिखाने के प्रतिकार से कोश का संग्रह करे।
english: Or he should bring about the gathering of the treasury by the remedy of the showing of the contrivance.
notes: The compound is ambiguous: it may be a dvandva "by showing contrivances and by remedy"; yoga = secret contrivance (glossary, Book 12 sense). The context (units 39-44: a portent is shown, then removed for a fee) favours the dvandva reading 'by the showing of contrivances and their remedy'; the printed rendering is kept literal.
lines_deva: योग.दर्शन.प्रतीकारेण वा कोश.अभिसंहरणं कुर्यात्
lines_iast: yoga.darśana.pratīkāreṇa vā kośa.abhisaṃharaṇaṃ kuryāt

words.gloss: agent in the guise of a trader

hindi: अथवा व्यापारी के वेश वाला गुप्तचर, प्रचुर माल और शिष्यों वाला, व्यापार करे।
english: Or an agent in the guise of a trader, with abundant wares and apprentices, should carry on business.
notes: antevāsin is "pupil, apprentice, one living near".
lines_deva: वैदेहक.व्यञ्जनो वा प्रभूत.पण्य.अन्तेवासी व्यवहरेत
lines_iast: vaidehaka.vyañjano vā prabhūta.paṇya.antevāsī vyavahareta

hindi: वह जब माल के मूल्य में निक्षेपों और प्रयोगों से बढ़ गया हो, तब उसे रात में लुटवाए।
english: When he has become increased in the value of wares by deposits and loans, then he should have him robbed at night.
notes: prayoga is taken as placing out (loans, investment); upacita "increased, accumulated" in the value of wares is slightly obscure.
lines_deva: स यदा पण्य.मूल्ये निक्षेप.प्रयोगैर् उपचितः स्यात् तदा-एनं रात्रौ मोषयेत्
lines_iast: sa yadā paṇya.mūlye nikṣepa.prayogair upacitaḥ syāt tadā-enaṃ rātrau moṣayet

hindi: इससे रूपदर्शक और स्वर्णकार की व्याख्या हो गई।
english: By this the examiner of coins and the goldsmith have been explained.
notes: rūpa = coin; rūpa-darśaka "coin examiner".
lines_deva: एतेन रूप.दर्शकः सुवर्ण.कारश् च व्याख्यातौ
lines_iast: etena rūpa.darśakaḥ suvarṇa.kāraś ca vyākhyātau

words.gloss: agent in the guise of a trader

hindi: अथवा व्यापारी के वेश वाला गुप्तचर, प्रसिद्ध व्यवहार वाला, प्रहवण के निमित्त उधार लिए हुए या किराये पर लिए हुए चाँदी और सोने के बहुत से भाण्ड ले।
english: Or an agent in the guise of a trader, of well-known dealings, should take, for the purpose of prahavaṇa, many articles of silver and gold, borrowed or hired.
notes: prahavaṇa is obscure and left untranslated (glossary). avakrītaka "hired" is a medium-confidence reading (avakraya = hire); alternative "bought". bhāṇḍa = vessel or article.
lines_deva: वैदेहक.व्यञ्जनो वा प्रख्यात.व्यवहारः प्रहवण.निमित्तं याचितकम् अवक्रीतकं वा रूप्य.सुवर्ण.भाण्डम् अनेकं गृह्णीयात्
lines_iast: vaidehaka.vyañjano vā prakhyāta.vyavahāraḥ prahavaṇa.nimittaṃ yācitakam avakrītakaṃ vā rūpya.suvarṇa.bhāṇḍam anekaṃ gṛhṇīyāt

words.gloss: by a collection of all wares

hindi: अथवा सभा में सब माल के संग्रह से प्रचुर धन और सोना ऋण के रूप में ले, और प्रतिभाण्ड का मूल्य भी।
english: Or at a gathering, by a collection of all wares, he should take abundant money and gold as a loan, and the price of the pratibhāṇḍa.
notes: pratibhāṇḍa is obscure (perhaps "counter-article" or "pledge"); left untranslated. Whether pratibhāṇḍa-mūlyam is a second object of gṛhṇīyāt is not certain. "ca" is placed after it in the Sanskrit.
lines_deva: समाजे वा सर्व.पण्य.सन्दोहेन प्रभूतं हिरण्य.सुवर्णम् ऋणं गृह्णीयात्, प्रतिभाण्ड.मूल्यं च
lines_iast: samāje vā sarva.paṇya.sandohena prabhūtaṃ hiraṇya.suvarṇam ṛṇaṃ gṛhṇīyāt, pratibhāṇḍa.mūlyaṃ ca

hindi: उन दोनों को रात में लुटवाए।
english: He should have both of those robbed at night.
lines_deva: तद् उभयं रात्रौ मोषयेत्
lines_iast: tad ubhayaṃ rātrau moṣayet

words.gloss: in the guise of virtuous women

hindi: साध्वी स्त्रियों के वेश वाली स्त्रियों द्वारा दूष्यों को उन्मत्त करके और उन्हीं स्त्रियों के घरों में पकड़कर उनकी सारी सम्पत्तियाँ हर लें।
english: Having infatuated the treasonable through women in the guise of virtuous women, and having seized [them] in the houses of those very women, they should carry off all their possessions.
notes: The object of abhigṛhya ("them") and the possessor of sarva-svāni are understood as the dūṣyas.
lines_deva: साध्वी.व्यञ्जनाभिः स्त्रीभिर् दूष्यान् उन्मादयित्वा तासाम् एव वेश्मस्व् अभिगृह्य सर्व.स्वान्य् आहरेयुः
lines_iast: sādhvī.vyañjanābhiḥ strībhir dūṣyān unmādayitvā tāsām eva veśmasv abhigṛhya sarva.svāny āhareyuḥ

words.gloss: of the kinsmen of the treasonable

hindi: अथवा दूष्यों के कुटुम्बियों में विवाद उत्पन्न होने पर नियुक्त विष देने वाले विष दें।
english: Or, when a dispute has arisen among the kinsmen of the treasonable, poisoners who have been deployed should give poison.
notes: Hindi uses विष देने वाले for rasada, not रसद (which means supplies in Hindi and in the glossary for vīvadha); see 5.2 glossary entry. dūṣya-kulya could also be "family members of a dūṣya".
lines_deva: दूष्य.कुल्यानां वा विवादे प्रत्युत्पन्ने रसदाः प्रणिहिता रसं दद्युः
lines_iast: dūṣya.kulyānāṃ vā vivāde pratyutpanne rasadāḥ praṇihitā rasaṃ dadyuḥ

hindi: उस दोष के कारण दूसरों को पकड़ लेना चाहिए।
english: By that fault the others are to be seized.
notes: paryādā = take hold of, seize, take over; whether persons or their property is meant is not stated.
lines_deva: तेन दोषेण-इतरे पर्यादातव्याः
lines_iast: tena doṣeṇa-itare paryādātavyāḥ

hindi: अथवा अभित्यक्त दूष्य से विश्वसनीय बहाने से माल, धन का निक्षेप, ऋण का प्रयोग या दाय माँगे।
english: Or a condemned man should demand from the treasonable one, [on] a credible pretext, merchandise, a deposit of money, a loan placed out, or an inheritance.
notes: yāc takes two accusatives (dūṣyam, and the things asked). śraddheya-apadeśa taken as adverbial accusative, "on a credible pretext". dāya "inheritance, share".
lines_deva: दूष्यम् अभित्यक्तो वा श्रद्धेय.अपदेशं पण्यं हिरण्य.निक्षेपम् ऋण.प्रयोगं दायं वा याचेत
lines_iast: dūṣyam abhityakto vā śraddheya.apadeśaṃ paṇyaṃ hiraṇya.nikṣepam ṛṇa.prayogaṃ dāyaṃ vā yāceta

hindi: अथवा "दास" शब्द से दूष्य को पकड़े; उसकी पत्नी, पुत्रवधू या पुत्री को — "दासी" शब्द से या "पत्नी" शब्द से।
english: Or he should lay hold of the treasonable one by the word "slave"; his wife, daughter-in-law or daughter — by the word "slave-woman" or by the word "wife".
notes: The verb is not repeated in the second half; nothing is supplied. ālambeta "lay hold of, seize, lay claim to" is a medium-confidence rendering.
lines_deva: दास.शब्देन वा दूष्यम् आलम्बेत, भार्याम् अस्य स्नुषां दुहितरं वा दासी.शब्देन भार्या.शब्देन वा
lines_iast: dāsa.śabdena vā dūṣyam ālambeta, bhāryām asya snuṣāṃ duhitaraṃ vā dāsī.śabdena bhāryā.śabdena vā

words.gloss: at the door of the treasonable one's house

words.gram: pres. part. ātm. upa-√śī, m. acc. sg.

hindi: तीक्ष्ण उसे — जो रात में दूष्य के घर के द्वार के पास लेटा हो या कहीं और रहता हो — मारकर कहे: "यह धन का इच्छुक मारा गया।"
english: Having killed him — lying at night at the door of the treasonable one's house, or dwelling elsewhere — the assassin should say: "This wealth-desiring one has been killed."

text_flags.why: locative of dvār is dvāri/dvāre in the compound pratidvāra; the printed form is odd and may be a typing slip (possible)

notes: pratidvāri is obscure (a locative "at the door/opposite door", or a doorkeeper). The referent of "him" is not named; probably the condemned man of unit 55, but not certain.
lines_deva: तं दूष्य.गृह.प्रतिद्वारि रात्राव् उपशयानम् अन्यत्र वा वसन्तं तीक्ष्णो हत्वा ब्रूयात् "हतो ऽयम् अर्थ.कामुकः" इति
lines_iast: taṃ dūṣya.gṛha.pratidvāri rātrāv upaśayānam anyatra vā vasantaṃ tīkṣṇo hatvā brūyāt "hato 'yam artha.kāmukaḥ" iti

hindi: उस दोष के कारण दूसरों को पकड़ लेना चाहिए।
english: By that fault the others are to be seized.
notes: paryādā = take hold of, seize, take over; whether persons or their property is meant is not stated.
lines_deva: तेन दोषेण-इतरे पर्यादातव्याः
lines_iast: tena doṣeṇa-itare paryādātavyāḥ

words.gloss: agent in the guise of a holy man

hindi: अथवा सिद्ध के वेश वाला गुप्तचर दूष्य को जम्भक विद्याओं से प्रलोभन देकर कहे: "मैं कर्म जानता हूँ — अक्षय धन, राजद्वार से सम्बद्ध, स्त्रियों का हृदय, शत्रु में रोग करने वाला, आयुष्य या पुत्र-सम्बन्धी।"
english: Or an agent in the guise of a holy man, having tempted the treasonable one with jambhaka sciences, should say: "I know the action — inexhaustible money, relating to the king's gate, women's hearts, making disease in enemies, life-promoting, or son-related."
notes: The list of six items before karma is taken as adjectival/appositional; the Sanskrit gives no linking words, and none are supplied. rāja-dvārika and strī-hṛdaya are taken literally; the exact sense of each (for example winning women's hearts) is not stated.
lines_deva: सिद्ध.व्यञ्जनो वा दूष्यं जम्भक.विद्याभिः प्रलोभयित्वा ब्रूयात् "अक्षय.हिरण्यं राज.द्वारिकं स्त्री.हृदयम् अरि.व्याधि.करम् आयुष्यं पुत्रीयं वा कर्म जानामि" इति
lines_iast: siddha.vyañjano vā dūṣyaṃ jambhaka.vidyābhiḥ pralobhayitvā brūyāt "akṣaya.hiraṇyaṃ rāja.dvārikaṃ strī.hṛdayam ari.vyādhi.karam āyuṣyaṃ putrīyaṃ vā karma jānāmi" iti

words.gloss: with abundant liquor, meat and scent

hindi: स्वीकार कर लेने वाले से रात में चैत्य के स्थान पर प्रचुर सुरा, मांस और गन्ध वाली भेंट करवाए।
english: He should have the one who has accepted make an offering at the caitya place at night, with abundant liquor, meat and scent.
notes: The compound may instead mean "having abundant smell of liquor and meat". "the one who has accepted" follows the glossary.
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्नं चैत्य.स्थाने रात्रौ प्रभूत.सुरा.मांस.गन्धम् उपहारं कारयेत्
lines_iast: pratipannaṃ caitya.sthāne rātrau prabhūta.surā.māṃsa.gandham upahāraṃ kārayet

hindi: और यहाँ जहाँ एक रूप का, पहले गाड़ा हुआ धन, शव का अंग या मृत शिशु रखा गया हो, वहाँ से इसे धन दिखाए और "बहुत थोड़ा" कहे।
english: And here, where money of a single form, buried earlier, a limb of a corpse or a dead child may have been placed, from there he should show him money and should say: "Very little."
notes: The grammar is uncertain: nihitaḥ (masculine singular) agrees only with preta-śiśuḥ, so the exact relation of the buried money and the corpse limb is unclear. eka-rūpa may mean "single coin" (rūpa = coin) or "uniform".
lines_deva: एक.रूपं च-अत्र हिरण्यं पूर्व.निखातं प्रेत.अङ्गं प्रेत.शिशुर् वा यत्र निहितः स्यात्, ततो हिरण्यम् अस्य दर्शयेद् "अत्यल्पम्" इति च ब्रूयात्
lines_iast: eka.rūpaṃ ca-atra hiraṇyaṃ pūrva.nikhātaṃ preta.aṅgaṃ preta.śiśur vā yatra nihitaḥ syāt, tato hiraṇyam asya darśayed "atyalpam" iti ca brūyāt

words.gloss: for the sake of abundant money

hindi: "'बहुत धन के लिए फिर भेंट करनी चाहिए' — तुम स्वयं ही इस धन से कल बहुत-सी भेंट की सामग्री खरीदो।"
english: "'For the sake of abundant money the offering must be made again': just yourself, with this money, buy abundant offering-material tomorrow."
notes: Nested quotation: the inner iti reports the reason; both closing iti are shown by quotation marks only. The speaker and hearer are not named.
lines_deva: "प्रभूत.हिरण्य.हेतोः पुनर् उपहारः कर्तव्य इति स्वयम् एव-एतेन हिरण्येन श्वो.भूते प्रभूतम् औपहारिकं क्रीणीहि" इति
lines_iast: "prabhūta.hiraṇya.hetoḥ punar upahāraḥ kartavya iti svayam eva-etena hiraṇyena śvo.bhūte prabhūtam aupahārikaṃ krīṇīhi" iti

hindi: वह उस धन के साथ भेंट की सामग्री की खरीद में पकड़ा जाएगा।
english: He would be seized with that money at the purchase of the offering-material.
notes: gṛhyeta is an optative passive; "would be seized" renders it as a statement of result.
lines_deva: स तेन हिरण्येन-औपहारिक.क्रये गृह्येत
lines_iast: sa tena hiraṇyena-aupahārika.kraye gṛhyeta

words.gloss: in the guise of a mother

hindi: अथवा माता के वेश वाली गुप्तचर स्त्री क्रोधित हो: "तुमने मेरे पुत्र को मार डाला।"
english: Or a female agent in the guise of a mother should be enraged: "My son has been killed by you."

text_flags.why: possible: avakupitā syāt needs a nominative subject; the instrumental -yā does not fit

notes: The printed instrumental mātṛ-vyañjanayā does not agree with the nominative avakupitā; a nominative mātṛ-vyañjanā would be expected (possible typo). Translated as if nominative. Who is addressed is not stated.
lines_deva: मातृ.व्यञ्जनया वा "पुत्रो मे त्वया हतः" इत्य् अवकुपिता स्यात्
lines_iast: mātṛ.vyañjanayā vā "putro me tvayā hataḥ" ity avakupitā syāt

hindi: इसके रात्रि-याग, वन-याग या वन-क्रीड़ा के आरम्भ होने पर — सम्यक् सिद्ध ही — तीक्ष्ण अभित्यक्त को काटकर पार ले जाएँ।
english: When his night-sacrifice, forest-sacrifice or forest-sport has begun — [it being] just accomplished — the assassins, having slaughtered the condemned man, should carry [him] across.
notes: The unit is doubtful: saṃsiddham eva is not clearly attached (it may qualify the condemned man, "the one already perfected/prepared"). atinayeyuḥ literally "should lead across, convey away"; the object is understood.
lines_deva: संसिद्धम् एव-अस्य रात्रि.यागे वन.यागे वन.क्रीडायां वा प्रवृत्तायां तीक्ष्णा विशस्य-अभित्यक्तम् अतिनयेयुः
lines_iast: saṃsiddham eva-asya rātri.yāge vana.yāge vana.krīḍāyāṃ vā pravṛttāyāṃ tīkṣṇā viśasya-abhityaktam atinayeyuḥ

words.gloss: agent in the guise of a hired servant

hindi: अथवा दूष्य के भृतक के वेश वाला गुप्तचर वेतन के धन में खोटा सिक्का डालकर दिखाए।
english: Or an agent in the guise of a hired servant of the treasonable one, having thrown a false coin into the wage-money, should display [it].
notes: prarūpayet "display, present" (also "describe"); the object is understood. rūpa = coin.
lines_deva: दूष्यस्य वा भृतक.व्यञ्जनो वेतन.हिरण्ये कूट.रूपं प्रक्षिप्य प्ररूपयेत्
lines_iast: dūṣyasya vā bhṛtaka.vyañjano vetana.hiraṇye kūṭa.rūpaṃ prakṣipya prarūpayet

words.gloss: agent in the guise of a labourer

words.gram: pres. part. ātm. √kṛ, m. nom. sg.

words.gloss: implements of thieves and makers of false coin
agent in the guise of a physician

hindi: अथवा कर्मकर के वेश वाला गुप्तचर घर में काम करता हुआ चोर और खोटा सिक्का बनाने वाले के उपकरण रख दे; या चिकित्सक के वेश वाला गुप्तचर — गर, अगद के बहाने।
english: Or an agent in the guise of a labourer, doing work in the house, should place implements of thieves and makers of false coin; or an agent in the guise of a physician — gara, under the pretext of medicine.
notes: gara kept as a name (compounded poison, glossary). The verb is not repeated in the second half. agada "medicine/antidote". Whether stena-kūṭa-rūpa-kāraka is one or two groups is unclear.
lines_deva: कर्म.कर.व्यञ्जनो वा गृहे कर्म कुर्वाणः स्तेन.कूट.रूप.कारक.उपकरणम् उपनिदध्यात्, चिकित्सक.व्यञ्जनो वा गरम् अगद.अपदेशेन
lines_iast: karma.kara.vyañjano vā gṛhe karma kurvāṇaḥ stena.kūṭa.rūpa.kāraka.upakaraṇam upanidadhyāt, cikitsaka.vyañjano vā garam agada.apadeśena

words.gloss: through the mouth of a kāpaṭika

hindi: अथवा दूष्य के समीप का गुप्तचर भेजे हुए अभिषेक के पात्र और शत्रु के आदेश को कापटिक के मुख से बताए, और कारण भी कहे।
english: Or a secret agent close to the treasonable one should report, through a kāpaṭika, the consecration-vessels sent and the enemy's order, and should state the reason.
notes: kāpaṭika is left as a term (glossary). praṇihitam may qualify both objects, "sent". "close by" may mean close to the dūṣya (taken so).
lines_deva: प्रत्यासन्नो वा दूष्यस्य सत्त्री प्रणिहितम् अभिषेक.भाण्डम् अमित्र.शासनं च कापटिक.मुखेन-आचक्षीत, कारणं च ब्रूयात्
lines_iast: pratyāsanno vā dūṣyasya sattrī praṇihitam abhiṣeka.bhāṇḍam amitra.śāsanaṃ ca kāpaṭika.mukhena-ācakṣīta, kāraṇaṃ ca brūyāt

hindi: इस प्रकार दूष्यों और अधार्मिकों के साथ बर्ताव करे, दूसरों के साथ नहीं।
english: Thus he should proceed with the treasonable and the unrighteous, not with the others.
lines_deva: एवं दूष्येष्व् अधार्मिकेषु च वर्तेत, न-इतरेषु
lines_iast: evaṃ dūṣyeṣv adhārmikeṣu ca varteta, na-itareṣu

words.gloss: from fear of cutting off oneself

hindi: बगीचे से पके-पके फल की तरह राज्य से फल प्राप्त करे; अपने छेदन के भय से कच्चे को, जो क्रोध उत्पन्न करने वाला हो, छोड़ दे।
english: Like ripe [fruit] after ripe [fruit] from a garden, he should obtain fruit from the kingdom; from fear of cutting off himself, he should avoid the unripe, which causes anger.
notes: kopa-kāraka "causing anger"; revolt is the alternative (8.2 sense). ātma-cheda "cutting off of oneself" kept literal.
lines_deva: पक्वं पक्वम् इव-आरामात् फलं राज्याद् अवाप्नुयात्
आत्मच्.छेद.भयाद् आमं वर्जयेत् कोप.कारकम्
lines_iast: pakvaṃ pakvam iva-ārāmāt phalaṃ rājyād avāpnuyāt
ātmac.cheda.bhayād āmaṃ varjayet kopa.kārakam
